intro.text: A kingdom lying several months' journey east of Mountaincrest.

description.text: Its people are usually pale, with thick eyebrows, and do not drink alcohol. A records keeper somewhere in the kingdom tracks all of its noble lineages.
December looks as if she could come from there, and Geoffrim Satin and Petva drew up a lineage sheet presenting her as a member of a middling Lark noble house.
